name: Netter
description: The cave's stand-off body. Its head end is the weapon — a domed cephalothorax that is mostly gland, with two tubes pointing down the way it is facing — so the drawing is front-heavy where every other spider here is back-heavy, and the abdomen is the small half. Teal on the dome, the tubes and the fangs, because teal is what comes out of them (`ss.enemy.shot`) and lands as silk. Gameplay radius 11.

charge.description: the gait of something that would rather not close: short steps, and the dome over the glands swelling on its own slower beat while the two tubes track forward — it is loaded the whole time it is walking
